title: Fox Calls AMLO 'Stubborn,' Sheinbaum 'Communist, Not Scientist' in Home Interview
detail: In an interview recorded at his San Cristóbal home in León, Guanajuato for the YouTube channel Café Ciudadano, Fox calls former president López Obrador 'un pendejo' who is 'fijo en sus ideas' and incapable of governing, and describes President Claudia Sheinbaum as 'comunista, no científica,' accusing her of concealing her true ideological agenda from the country. The remarks draw swift backlash: Morena national president Ariadna Montiel Reyes calls Fox 'the maximum traitor of the Mexican people' and accuses him of being 'the father of PRIAN's rot,' while social media users note the apparent contradiction with Fox's own 2012 support for the PRI's return to power.
